notes: The skip button now goes to the next album. Pressing Next on the last song of an album lands on the first song of the next album in your Albums list, in the order the cards are in, which is exactly what the end of the album already did on its own.

It is the same handover, driven by you. The album you skipped away from and the one that takes over are read from the same list and the same order, so a run of albums keeps going whichever way it is moved on.
The option covers both now. Settings - More - Playback - Next album when one ends turns the roll off, and the skip button then wraps inside the album you started, exactly as a finished album does.

A playlist, a mix, a search result or a play-all of the whole library is untouched: Next on the last song wraps inside that list as it always did, because only a queue that is exactly one album rolls at all.

Skipping in the middle of an album is unchanged as well. Next walks to the next song of the album you are in, and Previous still wraps inside that album rather than jumping backwards into another one.
Nothing about the handover itself moved: an album still rolls on when its last song reaches its end, and the last album still comes back round to the first, so the music never just stops.
